name: electron-agent-debug
description: Runtime diagnostics for Electron apps: an attach-only MCP server plus the electron-debug Agent Skill

plugins.name: electron-debug
plugins.description: Verify or diagnose a local Electron app at runtime: read main, renderer and utility logs, evaluate code, take screenshots and accessibility snapshots, click and type in the real window, and trace a JS call into native code with an external debugger. Registers the bundled stdio MCP server (Node.js 20+).
